meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Database on Indian Economy (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Provisional on release; partially revised with the next quarter's release and revised again later. DBIE keeps the first and the latest version of recent quarters; both are kept.
meta.product: Standard presentation of BoP as per BPM6: first estimates (DBIE reports 58 and 1076)
meta.coverage: The first published estimate of every BPM6 line, for every quarter DBIE still carries an earlier version of; the latest is in external-bop6-lines
meta.note: RBI DBIE reports 58 and 1076 (whose BPM6 rows keep versions 58 has dropped), US$ million. 'First' is the earliest version DBIE still carries for the quarter (meta.versions names them); where it carries one version, first equals latest. Subtract from external-bop6-lines for the revision.
